categories.name: Living Room
categories.tagline: Décor for the heart of your home

products.name: Gallery Photo Frame Set
products.shortDescription: Five wooden frames in mixed sizes to build your own gallery wall.
products.description: Five frames in complementary wood tones and mixed sizes, ready to compose into a gallery wall. Lay the arrangement on the floor first, then hang — your wall, your story.
products.material: Wood frames, glass fronts, A4 and 15 × 20 cm sizes
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a dry cloth. Hang on appropriate wall anchors.

products.name: Wooden Desk Organizer
products.shortDescription: Compartments for pens, notes and devices — a tidy desk in five minutes.
products.description: A warm wooden organizer with slots for pens, a bay for your phone and room for notes. It turns desk clutter into a neat little cityscape you won't mind staring at all day.
products.material: Solid pine wood
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a dry cloth. Avoid liquid contact.

products.name: Rattan Ring Wall Planter — Cascading Green
products.shortDescription: A cane hoop planter with trailing jade vines — a waterfall of green for your walls.
products.description: The statement companion to our Pink Bloom ring: a suspended cane hoop holding a woven basket overflowing with trailing jade vines. The greenery cascades 60 cm below the ring, softening doorways, accent walls and balcony corners with living colour.
products.material: Natural cane ring, woven rattan pot, artificial trailing vines
products.dimensions: Hoop diameter approx. 40 cm; vines trail approx. 60 cm
products.careInstructions: Dust with a dry cloth or cool hairdryer. Keep away from water.

products.name: Rattan Ring Wall Planter — Pink Bloom
products.shortDescription: A suspended cane ring holding a woven pot of pink star blooms — softness for bare walls.
products.description: A hand-bent cane hoop cradles a woven planter filled with blush-pink star flowers. Hang it where the light is kind — hallway walls, above desks or on the balcony — for a floating-garden effect that is light, airy and utterly charming.
products.material: Natural cane ring, woven rattan pot, artificial flowers
products.dimensions: Hoop diameter approx. 40 cm; total height approx. 65 cm
products.careInstructions: Dust with a dry cloth. Keep indoors or in covered outdoor spaces.

products.name: Dried Pampas in Ceramic Vase
products.shortDescription: Fluffy dried pampas plumes arranged in a round ceramic vase — styled and ready.
products.description: A ready-made arrangement of soft pampas plumes in warm cream and beige, set in a round ceramic vase. No styling needed — simply place it where the room needs a little softness.
products.material: Natural dried pampas grass, ceramic vase
products.careInstructions: Do not water. Keep away from moisture. Shake gently outdoors to refresh the plumes.

products.name: Sunset Blossom in Pearl Vase
products.shortDescription: Fiery orange blossoms arranged in a pearl-textured vase — sunshine that never fades.
products.description: A hand-arranged bouquet of sunset-orange blossoms set in our pearl-beaded ceramic vase. The petals gradate from tangerine to golden yellow, bringing a burst of warmth to consoles, side tables and office desks — with zero watering required.
products.material: Silk-touch artificial flowers, pearl-beaded ceramic vase
products.careInstructions: Dust lightly with a dry brush. Keep out of direct sunlight to preserve colour.

products.name: Ribbed Glass Vase
products.shortDescription: Fluted clear glass that bends light beautifully around fresh stems.
products.description: Vertical flutes catch the light and softly distort the stems inside — a small optical trick that makes even supermarket flowers look styled. Lovely on dining tables and vanities.
products.material: Thick fluted glass
products.careInstructions: Hand wash with mild soap. Avoid sudden temperature changes.

products.name: Macramé Wall Hanging
products.shortDescription: Handwoven cotton cords on a wooden dowel — soft texture for bedrooms and entryways.
products.description: Hand-knotted from soft cotton cord, this macramé piece brings gentle bohemian texture to any wall. The natural fringe moves subtly with the air, adding warmth above beds, dressers or entry consoles.
products.material: 100% cotton cord, natural wooden dowel
products.careInstructions: Shake gently to remove dust. Comb fringe softly. Spot clean with a damp cloth.

products.name: Jute Flower Placemats — Set of 3
products.shortDescription: Hand-braided jute mats in a scalloped flower shape — rustic warmth for the dining table.
products.description: Braided by hand from golden jute and finished with a scalloped petal edge, these placemats layer texture under everyday plates and teacups. Set of three; wipe-clean and naturally heat resistant for kettles and serving dishes.
products.material: Hand-braided natural jute rope
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a barely damp cloth and dry flat. Do not machine wash.

products.name: Scented Candle — Ceramic Jar
products.shortDescription: Slow-burning soy candle in a ribbed jar — sandalwood, amber and vanilla.
products.description: Hand-poured soy wax in a ribbed ceramic jar with a wooden lid. Notes of sandalwood, amber and vanilla fill a room gently rather than loudly. When it's done, the jar keeps shelf life as a brush pot.
products.material: Soy wax, cotton wick, ceramic jar
products.careInstructions: Trim wick to 5 mm before each burn. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

products.name: Mini LED Table Lamp
products.shortDescription: A pocket-sized glow lamp in pastel shades — sweet for bedside tables and study desks.
products.description: A tiny lamp with a big personality. The frosted pastel shade diffuses a soft warm glow — perfect for bedtime reading, dorm desks or as a thoughtful little gift. Battery operated, so it goes wherever the evening takes you.
products.material: Frosted ABS diffuser, warm LED, battery operated
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a dry cloth. Remove batteries if unused for long periods.

products.name: Hanging Coco Basket with Blooms
products.shortDescription: A handwoven coir basket with pink lily blooms — cottage charm for any wall.
products.description: Woven from natural coconut coir fibre and finished with a braided hanger, this teardrop basket comes styled with pink lily blooms and greenery. Lovely beside doorways, on balcony walls or clustered at different heights for a garden feel indoors.
products.material: Coconut coir rope, artificial lily and greenery
products.dimensions: Basket approx. 18 cm; total drop with hanger approx. 55 cm
products.careInstructions: Dust gently. Fluff flowers occasionally; keep away from rain.

products.name: Walnut Decorative Tray
products.shortDescription: A carved-handle tray in rich walnut to corral candles, remotes and keys.
products.description: Turned from rich walnut-finish wood with carved side handles, this tray makes small things look intentional. Use it on the coffee table for candles, on the console for keys, or as a table centerpiece base.
products.material: Wood with walnut finish
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a dry cloth. Keep away from water and heat.

products.name: Amber Glow Pattern Lamp
products.shortDescription: A honey-amber mini lamp that casts rosette light patterns across your room.
products.description: Switch it on and watch the wall bloom — the faceted amber shade throws a constellation of petal-shaped light onto tables and walls. USB-rechargeable and mesmerising at night; a warm, forgiving glow for bedrooms, nurseries and cosy corners.
products.material: Faceted acrylic shade, warm LED, USB rechargeable
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a dry cloth. Charge fully before first use.

products.name: Handwoven Rattan Blossom Wall Set — 3 Pieces
products.shortDescription: Three scalloped rattan blossoms, handwoven in warm cane — an instant focal wall.
products.description: Our signature set of three flower-shaped wall pieces, each petal handwoven from natural cane around a rattan centre. Hang them clustered like a blooming branch above a console or sofa — the warm honey tones catch evening light beautifully and bring instant character to plain walls.
products.material: Handwoven natural rattan (cane)
products.dimensions: Large 40 cm • Medium 33 cm • Small 27 cm diameter
products.careInstructions: Dust with a soft dry cloth. Keep away from damp walls and direct rain.

products.name: Nature Canvas Painting — Set of 3
products.shortDescription: Three vivid landscape canvases — meadow, river and mountain — for a fresh gallery wall.
products.description: A trio of saturated landscape prints — a butterfly meadow, a tranquil river homestead and a misty mountain pavilion. Board-mounted and ready to hang in any arrangement; try a triangle composition like our studio shot for an easy designer look.
products.material: Textured canvas on rigid board, ready to hang
products.careInstructions: Dust with a dry cloth. Avoid hanging in direct sunlight.

products.name: Ceramic Coaster Set
products.shortDescription: Four speckled ceramic coasters with a stand — small detail, big polish.
products.description: Four speckled stoneware coasters with a matching stand. They protect the table and quietly make tea time feel like an occasion.
products.material: Glazed stoneware with cork base
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean. Not dishwasher safe.

products.name: Ceramic Pen Holder
products.shortDescription: A speckled-glaze ceramic cup for pens, brushes or a single stem.
products.description: A satisfyingly weighty ceramic cup with a speckled beige glaze. Pens today, brushes tomorrow, a single dried stem on Sunday — it earns its spot on any desk.
products.material: Glazed stoneware
products.careInstructions: Rinse with water. Not dishwasher safe.

products.name: Bloom Rope Wall Mirror
products.shortDescription: A round mirror framed in deep-green rope and bright blooms — jewellery for your walls.
products.description: Our most photographed piece. A circular mirror is framed with meticulously wrapped forest-green cotton rope, edged in wooden beads and crowned with a garden of vivid fabric blooms. It reflects light, adds colour and turns any blank wall into a statement.
products.material: Cotton rope on wood base, wooden beads, fabric flowers, glass mirror
products.dimensions: Outer diameter approx. 45 cm; mirror 30 cm
products.careInstructions: Clean mirror with a soft damp cloth; dust flowers lightly.

products.name: Woven Seagrass Basket
products.shortDescription: A sturdy seagrass basket for throws, plants or tidy-looking storage.
products.description: Hand-woven seagrass with firm handles and a sturdy base. Use it to hold throws beside the sofa, to dress up a nursery plant, or to make open storage finally look deliberate.
products.material: Hand-woven seagrass
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a dry cloth. Air occasionally. Keep away from damp walls.

products.name: Abstract Ceramic Showpiece
products.shortDescription: A sculptural matte-glazed form that anchors coffee tables and shelves.
products.description: An organic, sculptural form finished in a soft matte glaze. On its own it reads as quiet art; paired with books or a tray it becomes the anchor of a styled tablescape.
products.material: Ceramic with matte glaze
products.careInstructions: Dust with a dry cloth. Not dishwasher safe.

products.name: Artificial Monstera in Pot
products.shortDescription: A lush monstera that stays perfect forever — potted in matte ceramic.
products.description: All of the tropical calm, none of the watering. A full, realistically veined monstera sits in a matte beige ceramic pot, ready to soften empty corners from day one.
products.material: Fabric and plastic foliage, ceramic pot
products.careInstructions: Dust leaves monthly with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Keep out of direct harsh sun.

products.name: Bedside Table Lamp
products.shortDescription: A warm-glow lamp with a linen shade and turned wooden base.
products.description: A softly glowing bedside lamp with a linen drum shade and turned wooden base. The warm bulb tone makes late-evening scrolling gentler and bedrooms feel like hotels.
products.material: Linen shade, wooden base, standard E27 holder
products.careInstructions: Dust shade with a soft brush. Use bulbs up to 40W. Wipe base dry.

products.name: Round Oak Wall Mirror
products.shortDescription: A round mirror framed in warm oak — opens up entryways and doubles the light.
products.description: A clean circular mirror in a warm oak-toned frame. Perfect above entryway consoles or vanities, it reflects light and space, making smaller rooms feel open and considered.
products.material: Solid oak-finish wood frame, glass mirror
products.careInstructions: Clean glass with a soft damp cloth. Avoid hanging in humid bathrooms.

products.name: Textured Cushion Cover — Set of 2
products.shortDescription: Bouclé and linen-finish covers in beige and terracotta. The fastest room refresh.
products.description: One beige bouclé, one terracotta linen-finish cover — the pairing that works with almost any sofa. Hidden zippers and quality stitching make them feel far more expensive than they are.
products.material: Bouclé and cotton-linen blend covers (inserts not included)
products.careInstructions: Hand wash or gentle machine cycle in cold water. Do not bleach.

products.name: Brass Candle Holder — Pair
products.shortDescription: Antique-finish brass holders for taper candles. Warm light, instantly.
products.description: A pair of candlestick holders in a warm antique brass finish. Set the table for dinner or line them along a mantel — within minutes the room settles into a softer, golden mood.
products.material: Solid brass with antique finish
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Polish occasionally with lemon and salt if desired.

products.name: Terracotta Ceramic Vase
products.shortDescription: Our signature vase — a rounded belly and narrow neck in raw terracotta clay.
products.description: The vase that started the studio. Thrown in raw terracotta with a rounded belly and narrow neck, it flatters dried stems, pampas or a single bold branch. Beautiful with or without flowers.
products.material: Unglazed terracotta ceramic
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a dry cloth. Use a liner or dried stems to avoid water marks.

products.name: Framed Line Art — Set of 3
products.shortDescription: A trio of one-line drawings in slim wooden frames to compose a calm gallery wall.
products.description: Three finely drawn one-line studies — a face, a botanical stem and an abstract curve — presented in slim natural wood frames. Hang them together as a set above a console or sofa, or spread them across a hallway for a quiet, gallery-like rhythm.
products.material: Engineered wood frames, glass front, art paper prints
products.careInstructions: Wipe frames with a dry cloth. Keep away from direct sunlight to prevent fading.

reviews.comment: Hung the set above our console — instant gallery wall. Frames feel sturdy.
Warm glow exactly as described. My bedroom feels like a boutique hotel now.
Very realistic. Slightly smaller than I imagined but the pot is lovely.
Solid brass, not the hollow kind. Dinner lighting has never looked better.
Stitching is neat and the bouclé is genuinely soft. Ordering another set.
The monstera looks surprisingly real — guests always ask whether it's natural. Very satisfied.
Great weight and finish. The narrow neck holds pampas perfectly.
Ordered twice already. Everything feels curated, not mass-produced. Artnest just gets home décor right.
The bedside lamp gives the warmest glow. Delivery outside Dhaka took five days, as promised.
The cushion covers are so soft and the colours are exactly as shown. My sofa finally feels finished.
Beautifully packed and delivered on time. The brass candle holders made my dining table feel complete.
The terracotta vase looks even better in my living room than in the photos. Really happy with the purchase.
